name: Out of Time
source:
You sit across from a fortune-teller who insists your time is up and that you’ve missed out on life. One by one, they lay down cards, and with each draw, they reveal your unraveling fate. 

As you hear each answer, you begin to realize how you choose to face it.

[From [url=https://fromasloth.itch.io/out-of-time]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你坐在一位算命先生对面，他坚称你的时间已经到了，你已经错过了生命。他们一张一张地放下牌，每一次抽牌都会揭示你的命运。

当你听到每个答案时，你开始意识到你选择如何面对它。

[来自[url=https://fromasloth.itch.io/out-of-time]Itch.io[/url]]
